in_hebrew.name: יענגס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Jennings is derived from the Hebrew words ‘yanach’ (grace) and ‘gam’ (gift), which together mean ‘gracious gift’. In the Bible, there are no instances of this name being used.

in_greek.name: Ιωάννης
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Jennings is derived from the Greek name ‘Ιωάννης’ (Ioannes), which is translated as ‘John’. In the New Testament, there is a prominent figure named John, who is an apostle and the author of several books including the Gospel of John, the three Epistles of John, and the Book of Revelation.

in_latin.name: Johannes
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Jennings is derived from the Latin name ‘Johannes’, which is also translated as ‘John’. In the Latin Vulgate Bible, the name John appears frequently.
